title: Cherry blossoms are HERE in San Diego!
description:
Cherry blossoms are taking the spotlight! 🌸 Join us at the Japanese Friendship Garden’s Cherry Blossom Festival in Balboa Park, March 12-15. Visitors can enjoy cultural performances, local vendors, family activities, and stunning cherry blossoms throughout the garden.✨ For festival tickets and schedule, visit niwa.org/cbw

Free parking is available for everyone in the Lower Inspiration Point lot on Presidents Way for up to three hours, and a free tram will take you to the park. ADA parking is free with a license plate or placard.

For city of San Diego residents, register in advance as a verified resident to receive free parking in the seven general parking lots and discounts on parking passes and daily rates in the five premium lots. More information: sandiego.gov/parking/balboapark.
